_comment: Per-function gas LIMITS for the client. Monad charges gas_limit × price (not gas used) — set tight limits. Measured with `forge test --match-test test_gas_profile -vv` at EVM prices; Monad's cold storage/account access is ~4x dearer, so each is padded ~1.6x and MUST be re-measured on testnet before the client ships.
note: reveal_* limits depend on who reveals second; the client doesn't know in advance, so use reveal_resolving for the second-to-act side if it can tell, else the larger of the two. RANKED: every resolving reveal in a ranked bout must use reveal_resolving_ranked_end — the client can't know which reveal ends the bout, and a too-small limit makes the final reveal revert (the player then times out and takes a rated forfeit). 839k EVM gas measured for a KO ending (resolve + career records + rating + Belt mint); x~3 headroom for Monad's dearer cold storage; re-measure on testnet. LESSON (real testnet): the reveal that lands second also resolves the turn (2-5x the gas). A client that estimates gas just before the other seat's reveal lands sizes it for the cheap path and runs out of gas (mined, reverted, charged the full limit). packages/chain/src/duel.ts now floors reveals (400k, lead 650k), lets the human reveal first, and retries an out-of-gas revert with 3x the estimate.

measuredOnMonadTestnet._source: real transactions on Monad testnet (chain 10143), Arena 0x4e8a…294b, 2026-10-10; gas limits that SUCCEEDED (Monad charges the limit); estimates were ~1.14x lower
